structured_output.reason: Capital cities are a modeled Wikidata class, and coastal location can be filtered with P206 (located next to body of water) pointing to a sea, ocean, bay or gulf.

wikidata.where:
?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q5119 .
?item wdt:P206 ?water .
VALUES ?wclass { wd:Q165 wd:Q9430 wd:Q39594 wd:Q1322134 }
?water wdt:P31/wdt:P279* ?wclass .
FILTER(?item != wd:Q5119)
wikidata.notes: Q5119 = capital; P206 = located in or next to body of water; Q165 = sea, Q9430 = ocean, Q39594 = bay, Q1322134 = gulf. May include some sub-national capitals (which still count as capital cities). Landlocked capitals are excluded as they lack a sea link.
